items.title: CoinDCX confirms $16 million loss from retired wallets days after CEO called breach reports a ‘false alarm’
items.summary: CEO Sumit Gupta had told X users on Wednesday that early reports of a breach sounded like "a false alarm."

items.title: How a DAO Vote Becomes a Treasury Transfer
items.summary: Uniswap’s executed funding proposal shows the difference between a sentiment poll, a binding vote and the contract authorized to release tokens.

items.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Intuit Among 6 More Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
items.summary: Twenty-two companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, after Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell, Arm, Moderna.

items.title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
items.summary: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.
